name: 67301 · Independence, KS
findings: ZIP 67301 (Independence) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 67301 (Independence) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
53% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 67301 (Independence) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).
